Q: Show name, country, age for all singers ordered by age from the oldest to the youngest.
R: SELECT name ,  country ,  age FROM singer ORDER BY age DESC

Q: What are the names, countries, and ages for every singer in descending order of age?
R: SELECT name ,  country ,  age FROM singer ORDER BY age DESC

Q: Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer.
R: SELECT song_name ,  song_release_year FROM singer ORDER BY age LIMIT 1

Q: What are the names and release years for all the songs of the youngest singer?
R: SELECT song_name ,  song_release_year FROM singer ORDER BY age LIMIT 1

Q: What are all distinct countries where singers above age 20 are from?
R: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM singer WHERE age  >  20

Q: What are  the different countries with singers above age 20?
R: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM singer WHERE age  >  20

Q: What is the average and maximum capacities for all stadiums ?
R: select avg(capacity) ,  max(capacity) from stadium

Q: What is the name and capacity for the stadium with highest average attendance?
R: SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the name and capacity for the stadium with the highest average attendance?
R: SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1

Q: How many concerts are there in year 2014 or 2015?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM concert WHERE YEAR  =  2014 OR YEAR  =  2015

Q: How many concerts occurred in 2014 or 2015?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM concert WHERE YEAR  =  2014 OR YEAR  =  2015

Q: Which year has most number of concerts?
R: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the year that had the most concerts?
R: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: Show the stadium names without any concert.
R: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE stadium_id NOT IN (SELECT stadium_id FROM concert)

Q: What are the names of the stadiums without any concerts?
R: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE stadium_id NOT IN (SELECT stadium_id FROM concert)

Q: List singer names and number of concerts for each singer.
R: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id GROUP BY T2.singer_id

Q: What are the names of the singers and number of concerts for each person?
R: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id GROUP BY T2.singer_id

Q: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
R: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014

Q: What are the names of the singers who performed in a concert in 2014?
R: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014

Q: Find the name and location of the stadiums which some concerts happened in the years of both 2014 and 2015.
R: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2014 INTERSECT SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2015

Q: What are the names and locations of the stadiums that had concerts that occurred in both 2014 and 2015?
R: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2014 INTERSECT SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2015
